code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and sum(row.count(grid[r][c]) for row in grid) == 1]
    if not pts:
        return g
    color = grid[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]
    # Join aligned/nearby markers by their shared orthogonal rows and columns.
    rows = sorted(set(r for r,c in pts)); cols = sorted(set(c for r,c in pts))
    for r in rows:
        cs = sorted(c for rr,c in pts if rr == r)
        if len(cs) > 1:
            for c in range(cs[0], cs[-1]+1): g[r][c] = color
    for c in cols:
        rs = sorted(r for r,cc in pts if cc == c)
        if len(rs) > 1:
            for r in range(rs[0], rs[-1]+1): g[r][c] = color
    # For an L pair, route through one elbow; use the first marker row and second marker column.

        for c in range(min(c1,c2), max(c1,c2)+1): g[r1][c]=color
        for r in range(min(r1,r2), max(r1,r2)+1): g[r][c2]=color
    for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=4
    return g
'''
